newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX to decrease some natural gas margins Thurs..
newsitem.headline: NYMEX to decrease some natural gas margins Thurs..

text.p: New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) will decrease margins on all but the first two months of its Henry Hub natural gas futures as of the close of business today, NYMEX said Thursday in a statement.
For all but the first two months, initial margins will be decreased to $4,000 from $6,300 for clearing members; to $4,400 from $6,930 for members; and to $5,400 from $8,505 for customers.
For the February and March, 1997, contracts, the margins will remain at $6,300 for clearing members; $6,930 for members; and $8,505 for customers.
